payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how the location of conferences can influence the diversity of participation in NLP research, particularly by encouraging local researchers to attend and increasing overall diversity.

claims.text: Conferences held in different locations can increase local participation, thereby enhancing diversity in NLP research.
The relationship between conference location and diversity of participation has been quantitatively explored, indicating that location impacts diversity outcomes.
Events like LREC attract a more diverse audience compared to others, suggesting that location affects participation diversity.
